items.title: Christmas in The Village
items.summary: Christmas in the Village returns to Streetsville for its 11th annual holiday celebration! m. m. m. for a festive weekend filled with holiday cheer in the heart of historic Streetsville. The festivities begin Friday evening with live music from The Canadiana Band , followed by the beloved Tree Lighting Ceremony , hosted by CBC News Peel’s Nav Nanwa .

items.title: An Evening of Piano: A City in Tune Exhibition
items.summary: Experience an unforgettable evening of live music at the historic Adamson Estate, where the stories and artists featured in A City in Tune will come to life through a special after-hours performance. The evening will feature award-winning Mississauga vocalist Heather Christine and acclaimed Canadian pianist Bill King , whose talents and contributions to the music community make them ideal performers to celebrate the exhibition.

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Christmas Canadian Pet Expo
items.summary: Get ready for a tail-wagging holiday celebration at the Christmas Canadian Pet Expo ! Bring your furry friends and experience a festive weekend packed with pet-friendly shopping, exciting demonstrations, interactive activities, and seasonal surprises. Browse hundreds of vendors featuring the latest pet products, discover unique holiday gifts, meet adorable animals, and enjoy entertainment for the whole family.

items.title: Breakfast with Santa
items.summary: A festive breakfast, a little Santa magic, and a chance to make the holidays brighter for local families.

items.title: Mississauga Santa Claus Parade 2026, presented by TD
items.summary: Bundle up and get ready for one of Mississauga’s most magical holiday traditions! The Mississauga Santa Claus Parade returns to City Centre with dazzling illuminated floats, festive performers, marching bands playing your favourite holiday tunes, and of course, Santa Claus himself. " , celebrates the special traditions, cultures, and festive moments that bring our community together throughout the season.

items.title: ORC Christmas Market
items.summary: The Ontario Racquet Club Christmas Market is back! Join us for the 3rd Annual ORC Christmas Market for a festive day of holiday shopping, local finds, and seasonal cheer. We’re excited to welcome 45 local vendors offering handmade treasures, unique gifts, festive finds, and plenty of holiday inspiration. Whether you’re getting a head start on your Christmas shopping, looking for something special, or simply want to enjoy a festive morning out, there will be something for everyone!

items.title: CHOCOLA-TO
items.summary: Calling all chocolate lovers! 🍫 Indulge your sweet tooth at CHOCOLA-TO , a delicious celebration of all things chocolate at the historic Small Arms Inspection Building. From handcrafted treats and gourmet creations to decadent desserts and unique chocolate-inspired products, this mouthwatering event is a dream come true for anyone who loves a little sweetness. Meet talented chocolatiers, discover local makers, sample irresistible creations, and shop for the perfect gift for the chocolate enthusiast in your life.

items.title: THE WAY
items.summary: THE WAY is an immersive live music experience that brings together a diverse group of talented artists for an evening of cultural connection, creative expression, and genre-blending performances. Headlined by acclaimed guitarist and music producer Shallum Xavier, the concert showcases a unique fusion of Indian classical music, jazz, rock, pop, and folk influences, creating a soundscape that transcends traditional musical boundaries.
